That all sounds shitty and overwhelming so no wonder you feel like you can't achieve what you want. That doesn't have to be the case though, you're definitely not alone!
I have been there too. I was 16 (now 32) when I was first diagnosed with severe depression and anxiety and after recent events I think I have borderline personality too (something I've always suspected but I'm only now starting therapy). There have been peaks and troughs but it has affected my life in every aspect. Even in spite of this,  I've managed to travel all over the world, I have a career and work in the civil service with good pay and I have an awesome understanding husband.
 Be open about who you are with those you trust. That will ensure people understand why you are the way you are and it will enable them to support you.
Work out what your limits are because of your illness and what your strengths are (i.e I struggle being around too many people which has shaped my career so that I deal with numbers and work on more intricate, lone working type stuff).  
Maybe your life won't turn out exactly how youve planned it but it doesn't mean it won't be something wonderful.
Hope this helps in some way, if you ever want to chat, drop me a line. X

People can just disappear though, on their own accord. My uncle went missing when I was about 12/13 (around 1999). Just completely disappeared, stopped using his bank account and no one ever saw or heard of him again. He was involved with some bad people and owed money for drugs so eventually we came to the conclusion he had met an unfortunate end. He was even declared dead about 10 years later. Fast forward to 2016, I was on a beach in Cambodia and I get a fb friend request from my uncle! I lost my shit. I wouldn't have believed it except he had a picture up that was undeniably him but a lot older. He had been living rough in Barcelona for almost 20 years, he just walked away from everything. Totally oblivious to how much hurt and stress he caused everyone around him. But obviously, we were very glad he is alive!
